The 7z archive reader from the LZMA SDK 25.01 by Igor Pavlov
(https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html, lzma2501.7z, C/ folder), copied
unmodified: only the files needed to read .7z archives (LZMA, LZMA2,
PPMd, BCJ/BCJ2/branch and delta filters). MAME reads its .7z sets with
the same code.

LZMA SDK is placed in the public domain by Igor Pavlov:

  Anyone is free to copy, modify, publish, use, compile, sell, or
  distribute the original LZMA SDK code, either in source code form or as
  a compiled binary, for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial, and by
  any means.
